notesStmt.note: Whitman's note at the top of the leaf indicates that he sent the poem to the Herald on May 19, suggesting that this manuscript was written sometime before that date, likely in late April or early May 1888.
The manuscript is a draft of the poem "Life and Death," which was first published in the New York Herald on May 23, 1888. Whitman also included it November Boughs later that year.

lg.head: Life and Death
lg.l:
For By as each successive age pass'd on
insoluble, pass'd on,
To ours to-day—and we pass on, the same
‸close home, Elusive, simple, present, baffled, grappled, foil'd baffled,
